newsitem.title: CHINA: China fixed asset investment up 18.1 pct Jan-Feb.
newsitem.headline: China fixed asset investment up 18.1 pct Jan-Feb.

text.p: China's investment in fixed assets rose 18.1 percent in the first two months to total 58.86 billion yuan, compared with the year-ago period, latest figures from the State Statistical Bureau showed.
In January-February, investment in capital construction was 33.65 billion yuan, up 17.2 percent, it said in a report released by the Xinhua news agency on Thursday.
Investment in technical upgrading was 9.87 billion yuan, rising 26.7 percent, while investment in real estate was 12.8 billion yuan, an increase of 11.8 percent.
